text:
Let the mind contemplate this transient Rama,
the woman who dwells in the brow of the king, in the cottage, in the bower,
in the business of trade, and in the company of women.
Let us, having entered the gates of the houses with our shawls and shawls,
stand in the rows of Varanasi, and beg for alms,
our hands extended, seeking sustenance.
